# evroc_lb_certificate (Data Source)

Looks up load balancer certificate metadata and readiness. Certificate content and private keys are never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "evroc_lb_certificate" "web" {
  name = "web-cert"
}

output "certificate_expiry" {
  value = data.evroc_lb_certificate.web.not_after
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Certificate resource name, unique within the project and region.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project containing the certificate. Defaults to the provider project.
- `region` (String) Region containing the certificate. Defaults to the provider region.

### Read-Only

- `certificate_id` (String) System-assigned certificate resource UUID.
- `certificate_sha256_fingerprint` (String) Observed SHA256 fingerprint of the leaf certificate.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp in RFC3339 format.
- `fqid` (String) Fully qualified certificate reference for HTTPS listeners.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `issuer` (String) Observed leaf certificate issuer.
- `not_after` (String) End of the certificate validity window in RFC3339 format.
- `not_before` (String) Start of the certificate validity window in RFC3339 format.
- `public_key_sha256_fingerprint` (String) Observed SHA256 fingerprint of the key's public key in DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo format.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the API reports the certificate ready for use.
- `subject` (String) Observed leaf certificate subject.
- `subject_alternative_names` (Set of String) DNS names and IP addresses in the leaf certificate SAN extension.
- `system_labels` (Map of String) System-managed resource labels.
- `user_labels` (Map of String) Labels set when creating the certificate. The API does not support updating certificate labels.
